scope: 56 body/wrist RGB pairs: 28 M1 and 28 M3; TRAIN and KIN-VAL; both commands; first and last selected families at first, middle and last active phase; two lowest required-cue margins per task and split
inspected: Both saved-image contact sheets were displayed at original contact-sheet resolution. Target colours and orientation axes in M1, and open contour/endpoints in M3, are visually distinguishable in the sampled images, including the lowest required-cue examples. No image was rerendered or altered in the policy dataset.
limitations: This is scoped human-readable inspection, not exhaustive manual review of all 13,243 new rendered image pairs. Pixel/count gates and saved-array raster replay cover the complete admitted population separately.
